speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Prurigo Nodularis. The combination of intense itching, "red bumps" (nodules) on the thigh, and your history of diabetes and hypertension is consistent with this chronic skin condition often triggered by scratching. Given your recent travel and lack of fever, infectious causes like insect bites or cellulitis are less likely, but I recommend a dermatology scan to confirm the nature of the lesions.
